mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 30 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year) signals persistent inflationary pressures that force restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises over prior 30 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% monthly) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.3pp increase in 3 months) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 0.2% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), declining housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals reduced consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and HOUST is below 1200, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
